thig3.7:1.1: n' atthi nissaraṇaṃ loke kiṃ vivekena kāhasi | bhuñjāhi kāmaratiyo māhu pacchānutāpinī. || ||
thig3.7:2.1: sattisūlūpamā kāmā khandhānaṃ adhikuṭṭanā | yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi arati dāni sā mamaṃ. || ||
thig3.7:3.1: sabbattha vihatā nandi tamokkhandho padālito | evaṃ jānāhi pāpima nihato tvam asi antaka. || || Selā. ||
